title: International Yoga Day.
bodyText: June 21 of each year shall be known and designated as "International Yoga Day"; provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-31]  International Yoga Day.  June 21 of each year shall be known and designated as "International Yoga Day"; provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 2019, c 102, §2]
